text: I selected a loose blue serge, which differed most conspicuously from my former garments, and borrowed a linen collar. Then he haled me to the dining-room, where the remnants of a meal stood on the table, and announced that I had just five minutes to feed. “You can take a snack in your pocket, and we’ll have supper when we get back. I’ve got to be at the Masonic Hall at eight o’clock, or my agent will comb my hair.” I had a cup of coffee and some cold ham, while he yarned away on the hearthrug. “You find me in the deuce of a mess, Mr ——; by-the-by, you haven’t told me your name.
